title: The diploma, in a sold house
logline: The 2011 diploma in its black frame, no mat, on a wall in a house with a SOLD sign in the window and boxes on the floor. The frame is the last thing up.

panels.composition: A living room mid-move: boxes taped, a SOLD sign propped in the window facing out, bare walls, and one black frame still hanging — a diploma, no mat. The last thing to come down. Afternoon light.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a living room with taped moving boxes and a SOLD sign propped in the window and one black-framed diploma still hanging alone on a bare wall, afternoon light, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The last thing on the wall.
